papers.title_en: Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yifan Wang, Gordon Guocheng Qian, Yanyu Li, Anil Kag, Yun Fu
papers.evidence: 利用奖励导出的信用分配进行视频生成的词元级强化学习
papers.tldr: 视频生成强化学习通常给整段视频一个标量奖励，无法定位哪些视觉token已满足提示、哪些仍需修正。TVRL利用冻结视觉语言模型的答案似然提供视频级奖励，并用视频输入梯度幅度构造token级信用图。该方法在GRPO裁剪比率内用信用图重加权去噪转移对数概率。VBench-2.0总体达57.69，较基座提升3.60分，并在多种采样器和奖励模型上稳定优于GRPO基线。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for video generation usually assigns one scalar reward to an entire sampled video. Yet a video is not uniformly flawed: some visual tokens may already satisfy the prompt, whereas others require correction. A scalar reward cannot localize errors, causing optimization to perturb satisfactory tokens while under-targeting the tokens that actually need to change. We introduce Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning, TVRL, a framework that derives token-level credit from the reward being optimized. Our key insight is that the answer likelihood of a frozen vision-language model provides both signals: its outputs contribute to the video-level reward, while magnitudes of its video-input gradients reveal which generated video tokens most affect that score. We instantiate TVRL in Group Relative Policy Optimization by averaging prompt-derived question rewards into one group-relative advantage and using detached, question-conditioned token-credit maps to reweight dense denoising-transition log-probabilities inside the clipped policy ratio. On VBench-2.0, TVRL achieves an Overall score of 57.69, outperforming the base model by 3.60 points. TVRL also improves matched GRPO baselines across three SDE samplers (SAGE, Flow, and Dance) by 2.68--3.15 points and across four reward models (VideoAlign, VideoScore2, UnifiedReward2, and Qwen3.5-9B) by 1.33--3.15 points.

papers.title_en: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Zhenglin Wan, Jiayu Chen, Zhengfeiyang Zhang, Pengfei Zhou, Wangbo Zhao, Fangyuan Kong, Pengfei Wan, Kun Gai, Yang You
papers.evidence: 以聚合优先奖励倾斜的在线强化学习微调扩散模型
papers.tldr: 在线强化学习微调扩散模型时，逆向过程方法受信用分配差拖累，前向方法高效却依赖EMA且不稳定。DiffusionART把每个提示词的奖励聚合成共享的提升方向，从构造上消除隐藏的前向-逆向一致性力，并用信任域掩码二次更新实现漂移自适应恢复。它在图像与视频生成中免逐任务调参、稳定高效；在HunyuanVideo-13B上以少12.02倍和11.72倍GPU小时达到DiffusionNFT与Flow-GRPO-Fast后期奖励水平，平均训练奖励还高28.8%和53.0%。
papers.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tunes diffusion models with black-box rewards, but reverse-process methods such as Flow-GRPO are limited in efficiency by poor credit assignment, while forward-process methods such as DiffusionNFT are efficient yet unstable without carefully tuned exponential-moving-average (EMA) off-policy training. We show that NFT-style objectives contain a hidden forward--reverse consistency force that joint positive--negative training cancels only partially, and that EMA stabilizes training through restoration rather than off-policy rollouts. We introduce DiffusionART (Diffusion Reinforcement with Aggregation-First Reward Tilting), which aggregates each prompt's rewards into a shared reward-improving direction for reverse-process states, removing the consistency force by construction, and adds a trust-region-masked second update for drift-adaptive restoration without EMA tuning. It requires no differentiable reward model, remains effective with fewer samples per prompt, and supports pairwise reward models (DiffusionART-Pairwise). Across image and video generation, DiffusionART trains efficiently and stably without per-task tuning. In particular, on HunyuanVideo-13B with equally weighted visual and motion quality rewards, DiffusionART reaches the late-stage mean reward levels of DiffusionNFT and Flow-GRPO-Fast with 12.02 and 11.72 times fewer GPU hours, respectively, while achieving 28.8% and 53.0% higher mean training rewards.

papers.title_en: Unified Generative Video Compression with Autoregressive and Bidirectional Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Tianyu Zhang, Shuai Huo, Dengchao Jin, Hewei Liu, Meng Lei, Tianwen Wu, Jiawen Gu, Chao Zhou, Li Li, Dong Liu
papers.evidence: 结合自回归与双向视频扩散的生成式视频压缩
papers.tldr: 视频扩散编解码在超低码率下重建质量好，但双向模型需整段序列、延迟高，自回归模型适合流式却压缩效率受限。UniGVC用单一比特流支持两种解码：BI-DiT负责高质量随机访问，窗口化AR-DiT负责低延迟流式，并共享分层潜在条件。BI还作为教师单步蒸馏AR，小解码器进一步降延迟。1080p下BI取得最佳率失真感知权衡，AR以36.85 FPS解码且比BI快250倍。
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models can reconstruct visually compelling content from severely compressed representations at ultra-low bitrates, but they impose a rigid deployment trade-off. Bidirectional (BI) models achieve high quality through dense full-sequence attention, yet require the entire sequence before reconstruction and incur substantial latency. Autoregressive (AR) models enable low-delay streaming, but their restricted temporal context reduces compression efficiency. This tension is particularly relevant when a video stream must be decoded in real time yet is also stored for later, quality-oriented playback, making AR and BI models natural choices for the live and replay stages, respectively. To support both stages, we present UniGVC, a Unified Generative Video Codec that supports two decoding modes from a single bitstream. UniGVC-BI employs a BI-DiT with dense attention for quality-oriented random-access decoding, whereas UniGVC-AR uses windowed AR-DiT for low-delay streaming. Both paths share a hierarchical latent codec that recurrently produces the same conditions with ultra-low bitrates, allowing UniGVC-BI to serve as a conditional teacher for single-step distillation of UniGVC-AR. A tiny conditional video decoder further reduces streaming latency while preserving most of the reconstruction quality. On standard 1080p benchmarks, UniGVC-BI achieves the best overall rate-distortion-perception trade-off among the evaluated methods and produces temporally stable video at rates as low as 0.0005 bits per pixel. Meanwhile, UniGVC-AR remains competitive while decoding 1080p video at 36.85 FPS, over $250\times$ faster than UniGVC-BI. Code and models will be released later.

papers.title_en: VideoAWR: Reinforcing Video Flow Models with Decoupled-Timestep Advantage-Weighted Rectification
papers.authors: Zheming Fu, Wenbin Ning, Ruizhe He, Wei Shang, Xiaoxiao Ma, Lianrui Mu, Chang Liu, Lei Wang, Siming Fu
papers.evidence: 用基于奖励的优势加权修正强化视频流模型
papers.tldr: 视频流模型用回归式强化学习做校正时，无CFG采样易冷启动崩塌，奖励差距失真；若改用引导采样又会在EMA更新下引发几何引导爆炸。VideoAWR将采样与优化锚点解耦：EMA参考策略产生引导rollout恢复奖励可分性，可训练策略仍对无引导条件锚点做优势加权校正，并引入解耦时间步校正提升样本效率。在Wan2.1-1.3B与14B上，训练稳定，CFG-free与CFG-enabled两种推理均提升视觉和运动质量。
papers.abstract_en: Regression-based RL for flow models mandates sampling \emph{without} classifier-free guidance (CFG) to align the rectification target with the reference marginal velocity. Extending Advantage-Weighted Rectification (AWR), which dynamically scales this regression target based on reward, to video generation encounters a cold-start pathology: unguided rollouts collapse into low-fidelity regions where intra-group reward gaps remain wide but no longer track perceptual quality, rendering the optimization target arbitrary. Conversely, utilizing guided rollouts to restore fidelity, while keeping the regression target tied to the guided sampling distribution, provably triggers a geometric guidance blow-up under exponential-moving-average (EMA) updates. We propose \textbf{VideoAWR}, which resolves this tension by untying sampling from the optimization anchor. An EMA reference policy generates \emph{guided} rollouts to restore reward separability, while the trainable policy is rectified against the \emph{unguided} conditional anchor. We prove this decoupled objective is mathematically exact: the centered advantage cancels the anchor in expectation, filtering out the reward-neutral guidance offset and retaining only the reward-correlated covariance increment. Consequently, inference runs single-branch and CFG-free, yet inference-time CFG preserves its original semantics. Furthermore, we introduce \emph{Decoupled Timestep Rectification}, supervising each rollout at an independently sampled timestep without bias to improve sample efficiency. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B and 14B demonstrate stable optimization and superior visual and motion quality in \emph{both} CFG-free and CFG-enabled regimes. Code is available at \pdfstartlink attr{/Border [0 0 0]} user{/Subtype /Link /A << /S /URI /URI (https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR) >>}% \textcolor{pearDark}{VideoAWR}\pdfendlink.

papers.title_en: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
papers.authors: Or Ronai, Vladimir Kulikov, Tomer Michaeli
papers.evidence: 基于码本的生成式扩散图像与视频压缩
papers.tldr: 无需训练的扩散/流生成压缩可复用生成先验，但Turbo-DDCM等码本方法依赖稠密高斯码本，内存与计算开销大且难扩展到高维隐空间，组合编码也重。H-DDCM以隐式随机Hadamard字典替代高斯码本，用快速Walsh-Hadamard变换实现O(d log d)投影/重建与O(d)内存，并引入免表字典序编码；视频端适配自回归流模型，以流式KV-cache前缀重编码保持时序上下文。图像与视频基准取得有竞争力的率-失真-感知性能，显著降低内存和计算开销，支持单GPU长视频近实时压缩。
papers.abstract_en: Training-free diffusion-based compression methods repurpose the generative priors of a diffusion or a flow model to compress data without retraining them as task-specific codecs. Recent codebook-based approaches such as Turbo-DDCM achieve strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, but their reliance on dense Gaussian codebooks remains costly in both memory and computation, and scales poorly with the large latent dimensions of modern image and video generators. Their combinatorial bitstream encoding further becomes computationally heavy at this scale. We introduce H-DDCM, a scalable generative compression framework that replaces Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform allows for implicitly synthesizing full-dimensional dictionaries with $O(d \log d)$ compute for projection and reconstruction and $O(d)$ memory, without materializing the full-dimensional dictionary. We further introduce an efficient table-free lexicographic coding scheme that makes combinatorial encoding practical at larger dimensions. Beyond images, we adapt the framework to an autoregressive video flow model and develop a streaming compression scheme that periodically re-encodes recently reconstructed frames into a fresh KV-cache prefix, preserving temporal context across segments at no additional transmitted bits. This enables long-form, close to real-time generative video compression on a single GPU. Across image and video benchmarks, H-DDCM achieves competitive rate-distortion-perception performance while substantially reducing the memory and computational overhead of codebook-based training-free generative compression.

papers.title_en: Neural Video Coding under Limited Delay: Theoretical Optimality and System Design
papers.authors: Likun Cai, Jun Chen, Ashish Khisti
papers.evidence: 神经视频编码的率失真分析与优化
papers.tldr: 传统神经视频压缩把零帧延迟当作固定约束，忽视有限延迟可访问未来帧相关性。作者基于马尔可夫网络团分解进行率失真分析，提出图因子化序列编码GFSC，用轻量神经模块增强现有因果预测编解码器。理论上证明K阶正分布马尔可夫源下，K帧延迟可在非平凡失真区域达到联合编码率失真最优。多模型多数据集实验显示率失真性能稳定提升，匹配延迟预算下可媲美双向编解码器。
papers.abstract_en: Traditional neural video compression (NVC) methods predominantly follow strictly causal predictive-coding paradigm, treating zero-frame delay as a fixed constraint rather than delay as an explicit design parameter. From an information-theoretic perspective, allowing limited frame delay enables a codec to exploit correlations with future frames within the delay window, thereby reducing uncertainty that is inaccessible to strictly causal prediction and potentially improving the rate-distortion tradeoff. In this work, we formalize this intuition through a rigorous rate-distortion analysis builds on the clique factorization of Markov networks, and propose Graph-Factored Sequential Coding (GFSC), a principled framework for sequential video coding under limited delay. To our knowledge, we provide the first theoretical result showing that, for general $K$-order Markov sources with positive distributions, a $K$-frame delay is sufficient to attain joint-coding rate-distortion optimality over a nontrivial distortion region, a guarantee unavailable to zero-delay causal coding in general. In practice, we instantiate GFSC through lightweight neural modules, allowing existing causal predictive codecs to be augmented without modifying their core architectures. Experiments across multiple NVC models and datasets show that GFSC consistently improves rate-distortion performance over the corresponding causal counterparts. Under matched delay budgets, GFSC also achieves competitive performance compared with representative bidirectional codecs.

papers.title_en: ResGVC: Residual Coding for High-fidelity Generative Video Compression
papers.authors: Ding Ding, Daowen Li, Ying Chen, Kai Li
papers.evidence: 面向生成式视频压缩的残差编码框架
papers.tldr: 生成式视频压缩通常依赖解码端扩散模型去噪，且在潜空间生成，缺少原始信源约束并受潜表示瓶颈影响。ResGVC提出残差编码框架：先由学习型视频编解码器重建，再将重建与原始画面的失真分解为逐去噪步的残差段，并用扩散Transformer熵模型压缩残差。该方法在去噪全程引入显式信源约束，直接在像素空间去噪。实验相对此前最优方法在LPIPS和PSNR上分别实现63.7%和83.8%的BD-rate降低，视觉质量更优。
papers.abstract_en: Generative video compression (GVC) methods usually employ decoder-side diffusion models to denoise reconstructed signals based on generative priors. Besides, most of these methods perform denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain. In this paper, we propose ResGVC, a residual coding framework for GVC that guides denoising toward original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments, where each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step. Residual segments can further be compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model. Unlike prior methods, ResGVC introduces explicit source constraints throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. The diffusion-based entropy model also enables more effective distribution modeling capability based on the powerful generative priors. Moreover, denoising directly in pixel space avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results show that, compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, while also delivering superior visual quality.

papers.title_en: ACWM-RM: A Reference-Free Reward Model from Complementary Mismatch Preferences
papers.authors: Shibo Hong, Siyu Ren, FengJiao Chen, Zhongyuan Peng, Wei Shi, Yixin Cao
papers.evidence: 构建按视觉质量与动作一致性排序视频的无参考奖励模型以驱动强化学习
papers.tldr: 现有奖励难以同时无参考评估动作条件世界模型的视觉质量（VQ）与动作跟随保真度（AF），IDM在生成视频上也不可靠。本文构建AVM-Eval评测集与AVM-Pref互补错配偏好数据，并提出ACWM-RM奖励模型。该方法先在真实视频预训练动作条件预测器学习前向动力学，再用分块加权评分头联合训练，以动作错配监督AF、视频错配监督VQ。实验表明ACWM-RM在VQ与AF上优于奖励基线，并为下游强化学习提供更可靠的无参考奖励。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has gained attention for improving action-conditioned world models (ACWMs), as it enables reward-driven optimization of visual quality (VQ) and action-following fidelity (AF) beyond flow-matching optimization. Realizing this potential requires reward signals that reliably rank videos by both VQ and AF. However, existing rewards capture only one dimension: metric-based rewards assess VQ but require ground-truth videos and do not directly assess AF, while inverse dynamics model (IDM) rewards assess AF without references but do not guarantee VQ. Moreover, IDMs, typically trained on real videos, may provide unreliable rewards for generated videos containing visual artifacts and physical inconsistencies. In this work, we introduce the Action and Video Mismatch Benchmark (AVM-Eval), comprising 67.2k pairs that evaluate how reliably IDMs assess AF on real and generated videos. We then propose ACWM-RM, a reward model that jointly assesses VQ and AF without ground-truth videos during reward computation. To train it, we first construct the Action and Video Mismatch Preference Dataset (AVM-Pref) with 506.3k pairs providing complementary supervision: action-mismatch pairs supervise AF, while video-mismatch pairs supervise VQ and expose the model to generated videos. We then pretrain an action-conditioned predictor on real videos to learn forward dynamics before jointly training it with a patch-weighted score head on AVM-Pref to transfer these dynamics to AF assessment on generated videos. Evaluation on AVM-Eval reveals the limited reliability of IDMs on generated videos, while downstream RL experiments show that ACWM-RM outperforms reward baselines in both criteria.

papers.title_en: GraftOOD: Grafting Out-of-Distribution Exemplars into Advantage-Weighted Rectification for Video Reward Optimization
papers.authors: Zheming Fu, Ruizhe He, Wenbin Ning, Xiaoxiao Ma, Xuan Yang, Lianrui Mu, Haoyang Huang, Chang Liu, Lei Wang, Siming Fu
papers.evidence: 结合优势加权校正与分布外样例的视频奖励优化
papers.tldr: 视频奖励优化常出现代理奖励升高却运动动态下降的“运动坍缩”问题。GraftOOD将部分在线 rollout 替换为分布外视频范例，并用共享速度回归目标融合组相对奖励校正与序列级范例监督。在 Wan2.1-1.3B 上，Dynamic Degree 从4.86升至44.41，HPSv3从8.10降至7.32，十项指标中九项领先。结果表明外部范例监督可补充标量奖励反馈，但需权衡动态与奖励。
papers.abstract_en:
Video reward optimization can increase proxy rewards while reducing video dynamics, a mismatch we identify as \emph{motion collapse}, including under a video-level motion-quality reward. We propose \textbf{GraftOOD}, which replaces part of the online rollouts in selected prompt groups with out-of-distribution video exemplars. A shared velocity-regression objective combines group-relative reward rectification with sequence-level exemplar supervision, requiring neither exemplar generation trajectories nor an additional supervised-loss coefficient. We characterize its pointwise optimal field as a source-posterior-weighted combination of the two source-specific target fields. We construct \textbf{GraftSet-Video}, containing 9,588 format-matched exemplars for 2,397 prompts, to supply external supervision. On Wan2.1-1.3B, GraftOOD raises Dynamic Degree from 4.86 to 44.41 relative to reward-only FlowAWR, while HPSv3 decreases from 8.10 to 7.32 and VisionReward remains close. At the main setting, GraftOOD leads nine of ten metrics among three exemplar-augmented methods. Ablations of exemplar frequency and within-group count reveal dynamics--reward trade-offs rather than uniform gains from increasing exemplar usage. These results support external exemplar supervision as a complement to scalar reward feedback, without equating higher measured dynamics with coherent, visually plausible motion in the generated videos. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR}{GraftOOD}.

---

papers.title_en: IsoVRBench: Video Reward Modeling Without Human Feedback
papers.authors: Shuyue Stella Li, Jacqueline He, Jiahui Chen, Sreya Dutta Roy, Yulia Tsvetkov, Luke Zettlemoyer, Marjan Ghazvininejad, Xiaochuang Han
papers.evidence: 基于受控偏好对构建的视频奖励模型基准
papers.tldr: 视频奖励模型常依赖人类偏好，但视频差异混杂多个属性，聚合准确率难揭示模型真正能区分什么。作者用受控干预固定其余属性、只改一个维度，自动构造8000对偏好并构建IsoVRBench。实验发现现有模型能分辨生成器整体质量，却在帧序等关键特征上失效，最佳模型仅60.8%，人类为100%。用这些干预对训练得到IsoVRM与IsoWan，并在VBench-2.0及人类偏好上超过人类数据基线。
papers.abstract_en:
Video reward models are trained and evaluated on human preferences between videos that often differ simultaneously on properties such as prompt alignment, visual fidelity, motion, and generator identity. As a result, aggregate accuracy does not reveal which video properties a reward model can reliably distinguish. We construct preference pairs by controlled interventions that change one property of a generated video while holding the rest fixed. The resulting pairs, by construction, provide preferences for how the videos differ along a specific dimension, without requiring any human annotation. We propose IsoVRBench, a video generation reward modeling benchmark of 8,000 such pairs across eight interventions, and show that state-of-the-art models separate broad quality differences between generators but miss important features such as temporal order. The best reward model reaches only 60.8% on reordered frames against 100% for humans, and rankings on existing benchmarks do not predict this failure. Using the synthetic isolated intervation pairs as training data leads to 1) IsoVRM, a reward model outperforming its counterpart trained with a larger human labeled preference dataset by 3.8 points on VBench-2.0, 2) IsoWan, the video generator post-trained with IsoVRM, outperforming its human-data counterpart in human preferences, and 3) gains that stack when combined with human data. Because intervention pairs are automatically generated rather than collected, the benchmark and training data can be easily extended as generators evolve.

papers.title_en: Recasting DiT for Extreme Image Compression with Hierarchical Visual Priors
papers.authors: Yunuo Chen, Jingnan Gao, Bing He, Jinjing Zhao, Chuqin Zhou, Xiaoyue Ling, Li Song, Guo Lu, Wenjun Zhang
papers.evidence: 将扩散Transformer改造为极端图像压缩的一步生成式解码器
papers.tldr: 极端图像压缩中，预训练扩散模型虽有强生成先验，但其随机迭代生成不适合直接解码压缩表示。PrismCodec将预训练DiT重铸为比特流驱动的一步确定性生成解码器，并利用投影编解码状态与层级视觉先验共同指导重建。通过渐进适应、一步蒸馏和扰动退火，无需额外条件比特即可从接收表示解码。在Kodak、CLIC和DIV2K上，其率感知性能显著优于现有生成式编解码器。
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for extreme image compression, but their stochastic, iterative generation processes are not designed to decode compressed representations directly. We present PrismCodec, which recasts a pretrained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) as a bitstream-grounded one-step generative decoder. PrismCodec uses the decoded representation in two complementary roles: a projected codec state defines the starting state for generation, while hierarchical visual priors derived from the same decoded latent provide semantic and structural guidance. To bridge the gap between stochastic, iterative generation and deterministic one-step decoding, we develop a progressive adaptation strategy. We first learn codec-conditioned transport from a noisy neighborhood centered on the codec state, distill it into a one-step mapping, and finally anneal the source perturbation to zero during end-to-end optimization. The resulting decoder reconstructs deterministically from the received representation without additional conditioning bits. Across Kodak, CLIC, and DIV2K, PrismCodec consistently improves rate-perception performance over prior generative codecs, achieving BD-rate reductions of 70-75% in LPIPS and 75-81% in DISTS over StableCodec. Code will be released upon acceptance.

papers.title_en: End-to-End Learned Image Coding: From Rate-Distortion Optimization to Practical Deployment
papers.authors: Ming Lu, Junqi Shi, Zhan Ma
papers.evidence: 学习图像编码的率失真优化
papers.tldr: 端到端学习图像编码（LIC）的率失真性能已显著提升，但实际部署仍受变码率、数值一致性、鲁棒性、复杂度与标准化等系统约束。本文从部署视角综述LIC框架，并梳理变码率控制、整型推理、通信鲁棒性、轻量化与互操作等扩展。作者提出TinyLIC开源基准，用于统一分析率失真—复杂度权衡。实验表明约10 KMACs/pixel解码即可在Kodak明显优于HEVC图像档，50 KMACs/pixel在多个测试集接近VVC图像档，为学习型编解码落地提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end learned image coding (LIC) has achieved substantial improvements in rate--distortion (R--D) performance, yet practical deployment requires addressing a broader set of system-level constraints. This article provides a deployment-oriented review of LIC, with particular attention to the transition from high-performance neural compression models to practical codecs. We first summarize the basic end-to-end coding framework, including learned transforms, quantization, entropy modeling, and R--D optimization. We then review practical extensions that are increasingly important for deployment, including variable-rate coding and rate control, integer-precision inference and cross-platform consistency, robustness and communication resilience, lightweight and hardware-aware implementation, and standardization and interoperability. To study these issues under a common setting, we further introduce TinyLIC as an open benchmark and reproducible case study for rate--distortion--complexity analysis. Experimental results illustrate the trade-offs among compression efficiency, computational complexity, numerical consistency, and robustness. In particular, TinyLIC with approximately 10 KMACs/pixel decoding complexity substantially outperforms the H.265/HEVC image-profile anchor on Kodak, while the 50 KMACs/pixel configuration achieves performance comparable to the H.266/VVC image-profile anchor on several test sets. The review highlights practical constraints and design trade-offs that remain central to the deployment and interoperability of learned image codecs. Materials are accessible at https://njuvision.github.io/TinyLIC.

papers.title_en: PerQ: Inverse Generative Modeling for Neural Image Compression via Quantization Error Compensation
papers.authors: Tianhao Peng, Ho Man Kwan, Fan Zhang, Shan Liu, Dave Bull
papers.evidence: 神经图像压缩的逆生成建模与感知率失真权衡
papers.tldr: 神经图像压缩难以兼顾像素保真与感知质量：失真优化码流低码率易模糊，生成式码流高码率PSNR饱和且需多模型。PerQ将感知重建视为有界支撑的逆生成建模，以量化单元为约束，在冻结多率失真骨干上附加率条件流匹配补偿器。实验在Kodak和CLIC2020上取得接近MS-ILLM的LPIPS/FID，同时保持与ELIC可比的PSNR。单一模型覆盖宽码率并快速解码，且可跨三种骨干稳定增益。
papers.abstract_en: Neural image codecs face a fundamental trade-off between pixel fidelity and perceptual quality. Distortion-optimized codecs preserve pixel-wise fidelity but produce blurred reconstructions at low bitrates, whereas generative codecs leverage learned priors to improve perceptual quality but tend to exhibit saturating PSNR at higher bitrates and require separate models for different bitrate targets. We propose PerQ, which reframes perceptual reconstruction as inverse generative modeling with bounded support. Specifically, we define the quantization cell as the set of latents that yield the same transmitted symbols and derive a transport bound showing that reconstructions from this cell remain within a rate-determined radius of the codec output. This motivates performing generative reconstruction within the codec-induced quantization cell, rather than sampling from an unconstrained image prior. PerQ implements this principle by attaching a rate-conditioned flow-matching compensator to a frozen, multi-rate distortion-optimized backbone, enabling perceptual enhancement while preserving the backbone's coding performance. Experiments on Kodak and CLIC2020 show that PerQ achieves perceptual performance comparable to generative codecs such as MS-ILLM in LPIPS and FID, while maintaining competitive PSNR relative to distortion-optimized codecs such as ELIC. A single model checkpoint supports a wide bitrate range with fast decoding, and the compensator provides consistent gains across three different backbones. The implementation is available at https://jasminepp.github.io/PerQ/.

papers.title_en: Bound-Conditioned Latent Inference for Progressive Image Compression
papers.authors: Jaeseok Jang, Seungmin Jeon, Kwang Pyo Choi, Chang-Su Kim
papers.evidence: 基于超先验的渐进式图像压缩与潜变量推断
papers.tldr: 渐进式图像压缩需从单一码流前缀逐步重建图像，现有 trit-plane 编解码器多把已解码 trits 仅当离散符号，忽略其对连续潜变量的区间约束。本文提出 BLI，将渐进 trit-plane 编码重构为区间收缩下的序列潜变量推断，利用上下界中心、宽度及共享超先验联合更新高斯参数与潜变量估计。在 Kodak、CLIC、JPEG-AI 上，BLI 取得渐进编解码器中最优率失真性能，Kodak 上较 DPICT 降低 BD-rate 17.78%、较 CTC 降低 7.96%，且共享模型参数约少 5.3 倍、时延更低。
papers.abstract_en: Progressive image compression reconstructs images from prefixes of a single bitstream and therefore involves sequential latent inference under partial observations. Existing trit-plane codecs mainly treat decoded trits as discrete symbols for probability prediction, without fully exploiting their role as interval constraints on the underlying continuous latents. We propose bound-conditioned latent inference (BLI), a framework that reformulates progressive trit-plane coding as sequential latent inference under shrinking interval constraints. At each coding step, the trits decoded so far define lower and upper bounds for each latent element. BLI uses the center and width of these bounds, together with hyperprior information shared by the encoder and decoder, to jointly refine the Gaussian parameters $(μ,σ)$ for entropy modeling and the latent estimate $\hat{y}$ for reconstruction. As additional trits are decoded, the feasible intervals shrink monotonically, yielding tighter constraints for the next inference step and enabling flexible in-plane refinement schedules. Experiments on Kodak, CLIC, and JPEG-AI show that BLI achieves state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance among progressive image codecs, reducing BD-rate by $17.78\%$ over DPICT and by $7.96\%$ over CTC on Kodak, while replacing CTC's plane-specific predictors with a shared model that uses about $5.3\times$ fewer parameters and achieves lower latency than CTC.

papers.title_en: Scalable Minimal-Change Learning for Controllable Image Editing
papers.authors: Shuo Chen, Fengming Huang, Yu Yao, Mingming Gong, Tongliang Liu
papers.evidence: 用视觉语言奖励模型与强化学习优化指令式编辑
papers.tldr: 指令图像编辑需只改目标属性、保留其余内容，但现有方法常产生非预期修改。作者将最小改动作为优化目标，用强化学习训练编辑模型，并以视觉语言奖励模型审计“未实现请求”和“意外改动”，通过组级评分规则生成无需逐指令人工标注的稳定奖励。在 FLUX.1 Kontext-dev 上，ARRO 将四个基准平均 EditScore 从5.21提至5.88，并在600例上把偏离目标像素改动降低8.4%。为可扩展的指令编辑提供无需逐指令标注的奖励优化路径。
papers.abstract_en: Image editing should change only the attributes specified by an instruction while preserving everything else, yet current methods often make unintended changes. We treat this minimal-change principle as an optimization objective for instruction-based editing. Latent L1 regularization is a poor proxy for output locality in modern nonlinear generators and often requires supervision unavailable at scale. We instead optimize edit outcomes with reinforcement learning. An agentic vision-language reward model audits each source image, instruction, and edited image for two failure types: unimplemented requested changes and unintended changes. A group-level rubric merges and verifies these issues to provide consistent rewards across candidate edits without per-instruction human annotations. On FLUX.1 Kontext-dev, ARRO raises average EditScore from 5.21 to 5.88 across MinEval, MagicBrush, AnyBench, and Emu-Edit. On 600 evaluation examples, it reduces off-target pixel change by 8.4% relative to the base editor. Reward and SFT controls, blinded human evaluations, and transfer to OmniGen2 provide complementary evidence. Code: https://github.com/Showwwwwwwww/ARRO

papers.title_en: Recast the Past: Stable Long Video Generation with Full Context Memory
papers.authors: Yukuo Ma, Cong Liu, Junke Wang, Junqi Liu, Haibin Huang, Zuxuan Wu, Xuelong Li
papers.evidence: 基于扩散变换器和完整上下文记忆的长视频生成
papers.tldr: 长视频生成需要保留不断扩展的历史，但直接条件于增长 token 序列成本高，压缩历史又可能丢失未来所需信息。ReCam 将历史潜变量的局部时空块聚合成向量，并投影到 Diffusion Transformer 的高维隐藏空间，通过原生自注意力以记忆 token 访问全历史。为缓解自回归展开的时间漂移，它采用双指针去噪，为近期上下文和目标帧设置独立噪声调度。实验在 VBench-Long 取得 80.1 总体分，并在 R2M-Bench 重访和离屏主体重现一致性上领先，服装一致性 4.09 优于最佳基线 3.03。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon video generation requires retaining an ever-expanding history, but conditioning on its growing token sequence is costly. Existing methods restrict or compress historical context, potentially losing information needed for future generation. This work proposes ReCam, which groups local spatiotemporal blocks of historical latents into vectors and projects them directly into the high-dimensional hidden space of a Diffusion Transformer. The model learns to use the resulting memory tokens through native self-attention, reducing token count while retaining block-level access to the full history. To mitigate temporal drift during autoregressive rollout, we further introduce dual-pointer denoising with separate noise schedules for recent context and target frames. Among the evaluated methods, ReCam achieves the highest VBench-Long overall score of 80.1 and competitive static-scene revisitation performance on R2M-Bench. It also leads on all four consistency metrics for off-screen subject reappearance, including clothing consistency of 4.09 versus 3.03 for the best baseline.

papers.title_en: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
papers.authors: Qiaoling Chen, Jiaxiang Cheng, Xueqing Deng, Tiankai Hang, Ji Hou, Jiaqi Li, Yifan Liu, Tao Lu, Junshu Tang, Yu Tang, Yao Teng, Yu Tian, Heng Wang, Weizhi Wang, Xiyao Wang, Xilun Wu, Mingyu Yang, Yangbin Yu, Rui Zhao, Longjun Cao, Linghao Chen, Haoyi Duan, Jiaming Han, Mingji Han, Enhua Jiang, Shunkai Li, Yanzhe Liang, Qinwei Ma, Cong Wang, Lei Wang, Bing Wu, Ke Xing, Ray Ying, Zhentao Yu, Key Zhang, Yuan Zhou, Zhengguang Zhou, Kai Zou
papers.evidence: 用于交互式时序生成的扩散视频世界模型
papers.tldr: 交互式世界生成要求模型在多轮指令中保持历史一致并体现动作后果，现有方法难以兼顾自由文本与连续相机控制。Hy-Nomas 以 8B 扩散视频骨干为基础，将结构化视频描述与动作感知因果注意力对齐，并用视觉语言 Prompt Enhancer 把用户请求与多模态历史转成下一段生成条件。多阶段课程逐步引入因果生成、文本交互、相机控制与自生成历史训练，再做扩散蒸馏。人类评估中优于现有世界模型，并开源权重、代码与基准。
papers.abstract_en: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive context remains accessible across segments, while action instructions are restricted to their intended temporal windows. A vision-language Prompt Enhancer (PE) translates user requests and multimodal interaction histories into structured conditions for the next segment. A multi-stage curriculum progressively introduces causal generation, text interaction, camera control, and training on model-generated histories, followed by diffusion distillation. In human evaluation, Hy-Nomas shows superior performance over existing world models. We release model weights, code and benchmarks, together with a lightweight adaptation workflow, to support reproducible research on interactive world generation.

papers.title_en: PWM: Personalized World Models with Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Zhexin Lou, Guancheng Lu, Zeyu Zhang, Yi Zhang, Yang Zhao, Hao Tang
papers.evidence: 用在线强化学习与奖励反馈定制视频世界模型
papers.tldr: 预训练世界模型虽能生成多样环境，却难以按用户短视频定制特定场景并保持动作条件生成质量。PWM 用在线强化学习，以支持轨迹和控制构造统一奖励，通过 GRPO 更新 LoRA 适配器并锚定冻结的 Yume-5B 先验。在 150 个任务的 PWM-Bench 上，GRPO 与 DiffusionNFT 分别在 71.3% 和 65.3% 场景优于原生 Yume。该框架实现真实与渲染环境的场景个性化，并兼顾定制增益与视觉质量。
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained world models can generate diverse environments, yet users often want to explore a particular scene specified by their own video. This requires learning the scene's visual identity while retaining the quality of action-conditioned generation. We introduce Personalized World Models (PWM), a framework for customizing interactive world models from short scene videos through online reinforcement learning. In PWM, the support trajectory and its associated controls provide reward feedback on continuations sampled from the current policy. In the GRPO instantiation, group-relative optimization updates a compact LoRA adapter using a unified reward for scene appearance, visual continuity, and motion, while base-policy anchoring regularizes changes to the pretrained generation prior of a frozen Yume-5B backbone. The same adaptation procedure is applied across real and rendered environments. We also instantiate PWM with DiffusionNFT as an alternative reward-guided optimization method for learning the scene-specific adapter. We also introduce PWM-Bench, comprising 150 customization tasks across Indoor, Outdoor, and Gaming, with paired evaluation on held-out continuations. The GRPO and DiffusionNFT instantiations of PWM improve customization over native Yume in 71.3% and 65.3% of the evaluated scenes, respectively, with positive mean gains across all three domains. For the GRPO instantiation, matched SFT comparisons further demonstrate higher mean customization gains and better mean image-quality scores in every domain, while retaining frame-level visual quality close to the pretrained model.

papers.title_en: Noise-Space Reward Alignment for Few-Step Generative Models
papers.authors: Woocheol Shin, Taeyoung Yun, Jiwon Sung, Hyeongyu Kang, Jeongmin Park, Jaewoo Lee, Kyuil Sim, Dohyun Kim, Yutong He, Jinkyoo Park
papers.evidence: 基于策略优化的噪声空间奖励对齐
papers.tldr: 少步生成模型虽能高效采样，却难以仅凭黑盒奖励对齐目标属性；直接微调易奖励过优化，测试时搜索又牺牲效率。NPO在初始噪声空间学习摊销流策略，将高斯噪声传输到奖励倾斜噪声分布，经冻结生成器推送即得目标输出分布。方法仅需采样端点做ELBO似然估计，训练后推理只增加轻量噪声采样。在图像、语言和蛋白质结构生成中，NPO取得更优奖励-质量权衡，并以低16至549倍推理成本匹配测试时搜索。
papers.abstract_en: Few-step generative models produce high-quality samples in one or a few evaluations. However, steering them toward desired properties remains difficult, especially when only black-box reward evaluations are available. While one could apply approaches developed for iterative diffusion and flow-based models, such as direct RL fine-tuning or test-time scaling, we find that neither transfers well to the few-step regime: direct fine-tuning suffers from severe reward over-optimization, and test-time scaling sacrifices the efficiency advantage of few-step generation. We propose Noise Policy Optimization (NPO), which explicitly targets the alignment problem for few-step generative models. The key idea is to learn an amortized flow policy over the initial noise space of the generator. The trained policy transports Gaussian noise to a reward-tilted noise distribution, whose pushforward distribution through the frozen generator is exactly the reward-tilted output distribution. By keeping the generator frozen, we can effectively utilize the knowledge encoded in the pretrained model, yielding a better reward-quality trade-off than direct fine-tuning. The amortized policy moves the search cost into training, so inference adds only a lightweight noise sampling step on top of the pretrained model. To improve sample efficiency during training, we use ELBO-based likelihood estimation that requires only sampled endpoints rather than simulated trajectories. Across image, language, and protein structure generation, NPO consistently achieves a better reward-quality trade-off than direct fine-tuning, and matches test-time search methods with 16 to 549 times lower inference cost.

papers.title_en: Personalize at Test Time: Learning User Preferences for Image Generation
papers.authors: Jiamu Bai, Jiaming Hu, Yanhong Wu, Zellux Wang
papers.evidence: 从偏好对学习个性化奖励模型
papers.tldr: 扩散模型生成质量高，但难以对齐个体用户偏好，且有限反馈下建模多样偏好是瓶颈。本文直接从用户历史图像偏好对学习个性化奖励模型：用自编码器将数百视觉属性压缩为50个属性锚定偏好维度并训练评估器，再将用户偏好表示为各维度得分的线性组合，基于Bradley-Terry模型估计用户权重。在真实用户偏好数据上，留出偏好对预测准确率约77%，并在保持扩散模型冻结时于推理阶段提升生成图像与个体偏好的一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models can generate high-quality images, yet aligning their outputs with individual user preferences remains challenging. A key bottleneck is accurately modeling diverse user preferences from limited feedback. Existing approaches often rely on labor-intensive manual preference annotations or vision-language models (VLM) to extract preference information from user interaction histories, introducing substantial annotation or computational costs that limit scalability. We propose an approach that learns personalized reward models directly from users' historical image preference pairs. First, we use an autoencoder to compress hundreds of visual attributes into 50 attribute-anchored preference dimensions and train an evaluator to score images along these dimensions. We then represent each user's preferences as a linear combination of the shared dimension scores, estimating the user-specific weights by maximizing the likelihood of their observed pairwise preferences under the Bradley-Terry model. This formulation reduces per-user adaptation to optimizing a low-dimensional weight vector, simplifying optimization and enabling data-efficient personalization from sparse feedback. The learned personalized rewards guide image generation at inference time while keeping the diffusion model frozen. Experiments on real-user preference data show that our approach achieves approximately 77% held-out pairwise preference prediction accuracy and improves the alignment of generated images with individual user preferences.

papers.title_en: Channel-Level Mask Guidance for Slimmable Image Compression
papers.authors: Chen Chen, Chenggang Wu, Yongbiao Chen, Weidong Qiu, Zhengwei Qi, Haibing Guan
papers.evidence: 可变复杂度可裁剪的学习式压缩
papers.tldr: 针对可伸缩学习图像压缩中连续通道选择损害窄模型低码率性能、变码率控制不稳的问题，提出通道级掩码引导方法。用稀疏正则学习通道掩码实现非连续top-w选择，并经M2S转换合并重排为标准可伸缩网络；结合λ/宽度调制、量化步长缩放和渐进训练实现单模型变码率。Kodak上三种骨干均提升率失真，w=48时BD-rate节省最高19.22%/24.11%/22.76%，单VBR模型替代40个模型、存储降14.8–15.9倍。
papers.abstract_en: Learned image compression (LIC) has achieved promising rate-distortion performance, but most methods lack scalability for diverse platforms with varying computational and storage constraints. Existing slimmable LIC methods achieve flexible complexity via consecutive-channel activation but suffer from two limitations: forced consecutive-channel selection degrades narrow-model performance at low bitrates, and the lack of stable variable-rate control limits adaptability to varying bandwidth. We propose a channel-level mask-guided slimmable image compression method. A learnable channel-wise mask with sparsity-promoting regularization enables non-contiguous top-w channel selection, letting narrow models use the most informative channels. After training, mask merging and channel reordering convert the model into a standard slimmable network via Mask-to-Slimmable (M2S) conversion, enabling efficient inference without architectural changes. For variable-rate control, we combine lambda- and width-conditioned modulation with quantization-step scaling and a progressive training pipeline stabilized by a freeze-then-fine-tune strategy. Experiments on Kodak across E2E, Hyperprior, and Checkerboard backbones show superior rate-distortion performance across widths and bitrates, with large gains for narrow models at low bitrates. At w=48, it achieves up to 19.22%, 24.11%, and 22.76% BD-rate savings over the same-width Slimmable baseline on E2E, Hyperprior, and CKBD, respectively. A single VBR model replaces 40 independent models, reducing storage by 14.8x to 15.9x. Code: https://github.com/sjtu-tcloud/MGSIC.

papers.title_en: Efficient Generative Image Compression with Quantized Latents Refinement
papers.authors: Hao Cao, Yinhuan Huang, Wenqi Guo, Zhijin Qin, Jungong Han
papers.evidence: 低码率下的生成式图像压缩与感知质量
papers.tldr: 生成式图像压缩在低码率下感知质量强，但高感知方法依赖扩散模型、延迟高，轻量方法速度快却质量下降。作者观察到低码率下粗粒度确定性量化会把对应不同细节的相邻潜变量坍缩到同一点。为此提出GR-GIC，以熵上下文引导的潜变量细化与自适应扰动提升重建，并用重组织投影残差向量量化P-RVQ加速推理。Kodak上相对OneDC在LPIPS、DISTS、PSNR、FID上取得显著BD-rate节省，A100编解码仅4.60/5.98毫秒。
papers.abstract_en: Generative image compression (GIC) delivers strong perceptual quality at low bitrates. However, GIC methods with strong perceptual quality often rely on pretrained diffusion models with high latency, while recent lightweight GIC methods reduce latency but deliver lower perceptual quality. We observe that, for lightweight GIC methods at low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can collapse nearby encoder latents corresponding to different fine details to the same point, making these details difficult to recover. Motivated by this, we propose GR-GIC, an efficient GIC that delivers competitive reconstruction performance with fast inference. For better performance, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR), which combines latent refinement guided by entropy context with adaptive perturbations for training regularization, jointly improving reconstruction at low bitrates. For fast inference, we introduce reorganized projected residual vector quantization (P-RVQ), which equivalently reorganizes residual updates into low-dimensional lookups to expose greater parallelism and reduce sequential computation. Experiments on Kodak show that for performance, compared with OneDC, GR-GIC achieves BD-rate savings of 23.19%, 37.71%, 22.30%, and 22.14% for LPIPS, DISTS, PSNR, and FID, respectively. For fast inference, the highly optimized implementation of GR-GIC encodes and decodes in 4.60 and 5.98 ms on an NVIDIA A100. Specifically, the reorganized P-RVQ implementation achieves a $3.14\times$ average speedup over the original implementation under the same FP32 setting. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, GR-GIC achieves latency comparable to lightweight GIC methods.

papers.title_en: Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Lei Wang, Zhen Wang, Yuexiang Xie, Yaliang Li
papers.evidence: 面向扩散生成模型的几何感知偏好优化
papers.tldr: 扩散模型偏好对齐常采用DPO式方法，但Diffusion-DPO在高维全空间直接优化偏好分布，忽略自然图像集中于低维流形的几何结构，导致切向更新被抑制、法向危险更新约束不足，逐步损害质量与多样性。为此，APO用参考模型导出的各向异性几何度量替代均匀欧氏误差，按去噪敏感度自适应加强正则并放宽安全语义调整方向。实验显示APO在多基准上对多种对齐方法平均胜率超60%，训练步数显著更少，且训练中保持生成多样性。
papers.abstract_en: Preference alignment has become a standard practice for text-to-image diffusion models. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) simplifies this process by eliminating explicit reward modeling. Its diffusion variant, Diffusion-DPO, has become a widely adopted baseline. Diffusion-DPO essentially encourages the likelihood of preferred samples while suppressing dispreferred ones. In this paper, we revisit DPO-style alignment methods for diffusion models from the perspective of the manifold hypothesis. Under this view, natural images concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold embedded in the high-dimensional ambient space, whereas DPO directly optimizes preference distributions in the full space without accounting for this geometric structure. This creates a mismatch in the optimization dynamics: it suppresses geometry-preserving tangential updates, while insufficiently restricting hazardous normal-direction updates. This mismatch gradually degrades image quality and diversity. To address this issue, we propose Anisotropic Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization (APO), which replaces the uniform Euclidean treatment of prediction errors with a geometry-aware anisotropic metric derived from the reference model. Concretely, APO adaptively strengthens regularization in directions where the reference denoising function is highly sensitive, while relaxing constraints in directions that permit safe semantic adjustment. This recalibrates preference optimization according to the local manifold geometry, and maintains the original manifold structure. Experiments show that APO achieves strong performance and an average win rate exceeding 60\% against various existing alignment methods across diverse benchmarks. It requires significantly fewer training steps than prior methods, and preserves generation diversity throughout training.

papers.title_en: Transforming Image Editors into Video Editors
papers.authors: Feng Wang, Zijie Li, Ceyuan Yang, Alan Yuille, Peng Wang
papers.evidence: 基于锚点的扩散视频编辑框架
papers.tldr: 视频编辑比图像编辑更难且成本高。本文提出 AVE，将视频编辑分解为稀疏关键帧编辑与跨时间传播两阶段：先用强图像编辑器编辑关键帧，再由运动引导的图像到视频扩散模型以关键帧为固定锚点生成视频。在 IVEBench 和 VIE-Bench 上，AVE 在指令遵循、时序一致性和内容保真上表现较强。该工作表明可复用图像编辑能力，避免昂贵端到端视频编辑训练，并为视频编辑提供轻量迁移路径。
papers.abstract_en: Recent image editing systems have achieved impressive semantic understanding, visual fidelity, and instruction-following ability, while video editing remains substantially more difficult and costly. In this paper, we present a simple alternative to end-to-end video editing: instead of training a monolithic video editor, we transform a strong image editor into a video editor through anchor-based generation. Our key insight is that video editing can be decomposed into two subproblems: editing a sparse set of keyframes and propagating those edits across time. Based on this observation, we propose Anchor-based Video Editing (AVE), a two-stage framework in which a powerful image editor first performs composed editing on selected keyframes, and a motion-guided image-to-video diffusion model then generates the final video by treating the edited keyframes as fixed anchors. This design directly inherits the strengths of modern image editors while avoiding expensive end-to-end video editing training. Experiments on IVEBench and VIE-Bench show that AVE achieves strong performance in instruction following, temporal consistency, and content fidelity. Further ablations reveal that final video editing quality is strongly correlated with the quality of the image editor, suggesting that future progress in video editing may come from stronger image editing foundations and lightweight transfer to video. Code is available at https://github.com/wangf3014/AVE.

papers.title_en: RM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Generative Reward Models
papers.authors: Qinglin Su, Licheng Pan, Zhen Fang, Jiakang Wang, Qingnan Ren, Yunsheng Lu, Yan Gao, Zhixuan Chu
papers.evidence: 基于偏好数据训练生成式奖励模型的两阶段同策略蒸馏
papers.tldr: 针对混合域偏好数据强化学习训练通用生成式奖励模型时存在的奖励稀疏与跨域干扰问题，本文提出两阶段RM-OPD框架，将专家能力获取与能力整合明确分离。方法先用单域GRPO训练各领域教师，再通过路由式在线策略蒸馏、域贡献重加权及可选准则上下文蒸馏，将教师整合为统一学生模型。在多个RM基准和两种基座上，RM-OPD稳定优于Mix-RL等强基线，并出现“教师超越”效应，为通用生成式奖励模型提供了有前景的新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning on Mixed-domain preference data (Mix-RL) has become the mainstream approach for training general-purpose Generative Reward Models (GRMs). However, Mix-RL suffers from two critical bottlenecks: the reward sparsity induced by outcome rewards, and the cross-domain interference arising from jointly optimizing heterogeneous capabilities, which together give rise to imbalanced capability acquisition and pervasive reward hacking. Inspired by the success of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in multi-domain capability integration, we introduce RM-OPD (Reward Modeling via On-Policy Distillation), a two-stage framework that separates specialist acquisition from capability integration. First, we cultivate domain-specialized teacher models via single-domain GRPO fine-tuning, allowing each expert to reach its performance ceiling in isolation; then we consolidate these teachers into one student model through (i) routed on-policy distillation, which provides dense signed token-level supervision on student-generated critiques; (ii) domain contribution reweighting, which reweights token guidance toward target domain shares, preventing specific domains from dominating optimization; and (iii) optional criteria context distillation, which conditions teachers on domain-specific evaluation criteria to sharpen token-level supervision. Across multiple RM benchmarks and two base models, RM-OPD consistently outperforms vanilla Mix-RL and other strong baselines, achieving overall superior performance and exhibiting an emergent "teacher-surpassing" effect. These results establish RM-OPD as a promising paradigm for building generalist GRMs.

papers.title_en: SCOPE: Semantic Bounded Credit Optimization for Prompt Engineering in Text-to-image Generation
papers.authors: Yufei Jiao, Jinfa Huang, Zeyue Xue, Tianyu Xie, Yuexiao Ma, Rongrong Ji, Xiawu Zheng, Jiebo Luo
papers.evidence: 用GRPO强化学习改写提示词优化生成器
papers.tldr: 现有强化学习改写提示词时，常把图像反馈统一施加到单个子词，忽略对象、数量、属性和关系等语义片段。SCOPE基于GRPO，让改写器同时输出增强提示词及其语义划分，并在每个语义片段内池化策略对数概率变化，为片段内token损失分配共享系数。在Qwen-Image、SD3和FLUX.1-dev上，较普通GRPO在GeneVal和T2I-CompBench分别平均相对提升9.48%和7.62%。消融表明语义边界与片段内池化均有效，说明语义结构可作为提示词工程的可利用归纳偏置。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables language models to improve text-to-image (T2I) generation by rewriting prompts for a frozen image generator. Existing methods typically apply a single signal derived from the image to individual subword tokens, although objects, counts, attributes, and relations form coherent semantic spans. We propose SCOPE, an objective based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that aligns update weighting with this structure. The rewriter jointly generates an enhanced prompt and its semantic partition. SCOPE pools shifts in policy log probabilities within each span to derive a shared coefficient for its token losses while retaining a single advantage for each completion. It requires neither separate span rewards nor additional image renders. Across Qwen-Image, SD3, and FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE achieves average relative gains over vanilla GRPO of 9.48% on GeneVal and 7.62% on T2I-CompBench. Ablation studies show that both semantic boundaries and pooling within spans contribute to these gains, supporting semantic structure as a practical inductive bias for prompt engineering with RL.

papers.title_en: Streaming-Aware Diffusion for Real-Time Video Super-Resolution via Cross-Step Attention
papers.authors: Harris Partaourides, Sotirios Chatzis
papers.evidence: 基于预训练潜扩散模型的高效视频处理
papers.tldr: 实时视频超分需在严格延迟下兼顾时空保真，扩散模型因迭代采样成本高且时序协调弱而受限。该工作提出流式感知框架，将预训练单图潜扩散模型适配VSR，并用跨步注意力复用相邻帧与去噪步的中间特征，实现无需显式时序建模的信息交换。轨迹耦合扩散调度进一步对齐相邻扩散状态，提升时序一致性。方法在REDS4与YouHQ40-Test上改善感知质量和时序真实感，冷启动后512×512达40 FPS以上，将有效复杂度从O(N·S)降至O(N+S)。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time video super-resolution requires high spatio-temporal fidelity under strict latency constraints, challenging diffusion models due to their iterative sampling cost and limited temporal coordination. We propose a streaming-aware framework that adapts pretrained single-image latent diffusion models for efficient video super-resolution (VSR) by exploiting the sequential structure of video streams. Our Cross-Step Attention mechanism reuses intermediate denoising features across adjacent frames and diffusion steps, enabling temporal information exchange without explicit temporal modeling. We further introduce Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling, which aligns adjacent diffusion states and provides cleaner intermediate representations for cross-step conditioning, improving temporal coherence. These components are integrated into a streaming inference pipeline that incrementally propagates latent states across frames, reducing the effective computational complexity from $O(N \cdot S)$ to $O(N + S)$ for $N$ frames and $S$ diffusion steps. Experiments on REDS4 and YouHQ40-Test demonstrate improved perceptual quality and temporal realism while maintaining frame-wise stability. Our method achieves over 40 FPS at $512 \times 512$ resolution after cold start, enabling real-time VSR without explicit temporal modeling.

papers.title_en: AV-FlowEdit: Training-Free Prompt-Driven Audio-Visual Editing with Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation
papers.authors: Shaohua Pan, Xiao Liu
papers.evidence: 基于扩散模型的免训练提示词驱动视频编辑
papers.tldr: 现有音视频联合扩散模型可生成同步内容，但编辑已有片段时易破坏非目标结构与跨模态对应。AV-FlowEdit提出免训练、免反演的提示驱动编辑框架，利用源-目标流差异同时给出编辑方向与保持线索，在共享扰动下联合更新音视频分支。方法还引入跨模态事件感知谱轨迹保持，结合流显著性、音频活动与多尺度低频位移抑制采样漂移。实验显示提示对齐与时序一致性较强，音频质量和跨模态连贯性具竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Joint audio-video diffusion models generate synchronized content, but editing existing clips requires target changes without disrupting non-target structure or cross-modal correspondence. We present AV-FlowEdit, a training-free and inversion-free framework for prompt-driven audio-video editing. Our key insight is that source--target flow differences provide both cross-modal editing directions and preservation cues. Under shared perturbations, they jointly update the video and audio branches, supporting visual-only, audio-only, and joint edits while retaining pretrained cross-modal interactions. To suppress drift accumulated during sampling, Cross-Modal Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation combines flow saliency, aligned audio activity, multiscale low-frequency displacement, and diffusion-stage scheduling. This adaptively preserves unsupported regions while allowing intended audio-visual events. AV-FlowEdit requires no model training, external masks, or optimization-based inversion. Experiments show strong prompt alignment and temporal consistency, together with competitive audio quality and cross-modal coherence.

papers.title_en: LightVAE: Towards Compact and Efficient Video Autoencoders
papers.authors: Shiqiao Gu, Yang Yong, Fengjun Zhong, Ruihao Gong, Chengtao Lv, Xiangyu Fan, Lei Yang, Xianglong Liu
papers.evidence: 紧凑高效视频自编码器降低编解码开销
papers.tldr: 视频 VAE 的编解码仍是潜在扩散模型生成高质量视频的主要计算瓶颈，现有轻量化方法没有区分空间压缩与时间压缩的敏感性。LightVAE 将因果 Conv3D 精确重参数化为聚合空间响应和由差分驱动的时间修正，并且只对时间修正做逐层低秩压缩，同时通过代数等价的折叠实现实际加速。它还结合保宽块剪枝和探针引导特征对齐来恢复质量。在 Wan VAE 上，解码吞吐达到 SOTA 的 2.24 倍；在 MiniMax-H3 上提速 2.97 倍，并保留 99.51% 的 VBench-2.0 分数。
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion models enable high-quality video generation, but video VAE encoding and decoding remain computationally expensive. Existing methods use stage-specific lightweight operators, yet either constrain spatial and temporal computation jointly or remove temporal computation altogether, without distinguishing their compression sensitivities in pretrained Conv3D. To address these limitations, we present LightVAE, a compression framework that exploits redundancy in temporal modeling and network depth. LightVAE exactly reparameterizes eligible causal Conv3D layers into an aggregate spatial response and a difference-driven temporal correction. Based on their distinct compression sensitivities, temporal low-rank compression (TLR) keeps the aggregate spatial kernel dense and applies layer-specific low-rank approximation only to the temporal correction. An algebraically equivalent folded implementation converts the arithmetic savings into practical acceleration. LightVAE further uses width-preserving block pruning to reduce depth and probe-guided feature alignment, guided by feedback from a frozen teacher suffix, to recover quality after compression. The framework also extends to video encoders. Across three video VAE backbones and two GPU platforms, LightVAE consistently accelerates decoding. For the Wan VAE family, it achieves up to $2.24\times$ and $1.11\times$ the decoding throughput of state-of-the-art efficient VAE decoders on NVIDIA H100 and RTX~5090, respectively, with higher DAVIS PSNR and lower LPIPS. On MiniMax-H3, it achieves up to $2.97\times$ the original decoding throughput while retaining 99.51\% of the original model's overall VBench-2.0 score. Our code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE.

papers.title_en: Co-Adaptive Entropy Modeling and Rate-Distortion-Optimal Bit Allocation for Perceptual Audio Coding
papers.authors: Soohyun Kim, Jiwon Jeong, Marina Bosi
papers.evidence: 自适应熵建模与在线概率估计及率失真最优比特分配
papers.tldr: 感知音频编码中熵模型与比特分配常分离，自适应模型还需边信息，限制单遍率失真优化。本文让二者跨块协同且无模型边信息，用分带在线概率模型混合编码尾数并同步编解码直方图，再把模型码率估计直接纳入率失真前沿，以动态规划精确最小化逐块预算下的感知失真。严格逐块码率下失真较无视熵编码的同一求解器降低15%–24%，协同再降3%–4%（双簧管最高15%），80 kbps/声道MUSHRA验证排序。表明熵模型与比特分配协同可在无模型边信息下提升单遍感知音频编码的率失真性能。
papers.abstract_en: We present a perceptual audio coder in which the entropy-coding model and the bit allocation co-adapt across blocks without model side information. Mantissas are coded by a hybrid of bit packing and arithmetic coding with per-band probability models learned online. Encoder and decoder accumulate identical histograms from decoded blocks and advance the same model state. The model enters bit allocation directly: per-band rate--distortion frontiers combine measured perceptual distortion with entropy-coded rate estimates under the current model, and a dynamic program attains the exact minimum of total objective perceptual distortion for each block's budget under the model's rate estimates, with reservoir carry-over. Under a strict per-block rate, entropy-coding-aware bit allocation lowers this distortion (band noise-to-mask ratio in linear scale) by 15-24% relative to the same solver without it, and co-adaptation removes a further 3-4% (up to 15% on oboe) that a backward-adaptive coder alone cannot realize in one pass; a MUSHRA test at 80 kbps per channel confirms the ranking.

papers.title_en: RDCompGS: Rate-Distortion Optimization for Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting with Image Codecs
papers.authors: Huiping Ren, Shuai Wan, Luqian Bai, Zhang Chen, Fuzheng Yang
papers.evidence: 可微码率估计实现率失真优化
papers.tldr: 3DGS虽可实时高质量新视角合成，但存储与传输开销大；将高斯属性映射到2D并借助图像编解码器压缩是有效路径。现有方法在优化中未充分区分不同高斯表示的编码码率，导致压缩后的率失真性能受限。RDCompGS将可微码率估计与渲染失真联合优化，并用码率约束调整模型适配不同压缩条件。在三个基准上，H.265/HEVC与JPEG XL下平均BD-Rate分别降低37.84%和49.31%，验证了整体率失真优化与码率估计的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis but requires significant storage and transmission resources. Mapping Gaussian attributes to 2D representations enables efficient compression using mature image codecs. However, Gaussian representations that achieve comparable rendering quality are generally treated similarly during optimization, despite substantial differences in coding rate, leading to limited rate-distortion (R-D) performance after compression. To address this limitation, we propose RDCompGS, a 3DGS compression method that enables overall R-D optimization of Gaussian representations with respect to subsequent coding. A differentiable estimate of the coding rate is incorporated into the R-D optimization with rendering distortion. The rate constraint adjustment model further regulates the R-D trade-off across different compression conditions. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that RDCompGS achieves average Bjøntegaard Delta Rate reductions of 37.84% and 49.31% with H.265/HEVC and JPEG XL, respectively. The estimated rate also shows a strong correlation with the actual bit-rate under different compression conditions.

papers.title_en: Progress-Guided Preference Generation for Aligning Generative Control Policies
papers.authors: Tung M. Luu, Tri Ton, Duc M. Nguyen, Xuan Thanh Nguyen, Nguyen Gia Binh, Quang Tan Nguyen, Vu Duong, Daniel Sonntag, Duy M. H. Nguyen, Vien Anh Ngo, Chang D. Yoo
papers.evidence: 面向生成式策略的无监督偏好对齐
papers.tldr: 生成式策略在模仿学习中表现突出，但受限于专家演示稀缺；基于偏好的微调可利用次优轨迹，却依赖昂贵人工标注。本文提出PGPG无监督偏好对齐框架，借助有序覆盖对齐衡量自主采集轨迹相对少量专家演示的序贯进度，自动生成伪偏好标签，并增强偏好可靠性以微调预训练策略。在多项长时程操作任务上，PGPG优于监督微调基线，且兼容扩散与流匹配策略。
papers.abstract_en: Generative policies have achieved strong performance in imitation learning tasks, but their success is often constrained by the limited availability of expert demonstrations. Although preference-based fine-tuning can leverage suboptimal rollouts to improve performance, existing approaches heavily rely on expensive human annotations. In this work, we introduce Progress-Guided Preference Generation (PGPG), an unsupervised preference alignment framework that eliminates the need for human-in-the-loop supervision. Our method leverages ordered coverage alignment to measure sequential progress relative to a small set of expert demonstrations, enabling the automatic extraction of pseudo-preference labels from autonomously collected rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce key enhancements to improve the reliability of these progress-guided preferences, enabling effective fine-tuning of pretrained generative policies without requiring manually designed reward functions. Extensive experiments across a suite of challenging long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that PGPG outperforms standard supervised fine-tuning baselines. Moreover, our conceptually simple framework is broadly applicable across multiple classes of generative policies, demonstrating strong versatility when integrated with both diffusion and flow-matching policies.

papers.title_en: SyncVid: World-Equivariant Diffusion for Synchronized Video Generation
papers.authors: Farhad G. Zanjani, Animesh Karnewar, Fatih Porikli, Amirhossein Habibian
papers.evidence: 基于扩散的同步多视角视频生成
papers.tldr: 从单段参考视频生成同一动态场景的多视角视频，需同时保持观测与未观测内容跨视角一致。现有相机控制视频扩散依赖相机嵌入、跨视角注意力和几何条件，难以维持细粒度动态几何。SyncVid 将单目视频提升为规范4D表示，在规范3D空间采样噪声并栅格化到目标相机，再用跨视角一致白化去除局部相关。该方法无需改架构即可同步扩散过程，提升感知质量与跨视角一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Generating multiple videos of a dynamic scene from a single reference video requires synthesizing both observed and unobserved content consistently across viewpoints. Existing camera-control methods for video diffusion typically rely on architectural mechanisms, including camera embeddings, cross-view attention, and geometric conditioning. Although effective for static scene content, these approaches often struggle with the fine-grained, dynamic geometry that must remain coherent across views and over time. We synchronize the diffusion process itself by sampling the Gaussian noise prior in a canonical 3D space derived from the source video and rasterizing it into target cameras, rather than sampling independently in each 2D image plane. Our method, SyncVid, lifts a monocular video into a canonical 4D representation, associates noise with scene geometry and unseen space, and rasterizes the resulting structured noise into arbitrary views. Because rendering can introduce local correlations, we further propose a cross-view-consistent whitening procedure that decorrelates neighboring pixels while preserving correspondence across views. The structured noise serves as the diffusion prior for a LoRA-adapted pretrained video diffusion model, requiring no architectural modifications. By enforcing spatiotemporal and cross-view coherence at the source of stochasticity, SyncVid generates synchronized videos and improves both perceptual quality and cross-view consistency in our experiments. Project page: https://qualcomm-ai-research.github.io/SyncVid-Webpage.

papers.title_en: Contextual Flow Matching: Adaptive Step Selection in Flow Models for Efficient Visual Generation
papers.authors: Divya Jyoti Bajpai, Arun Verma, Manjesh Kumar Hanawal
papers.evidence: 以奖励驱动在线优化的生成模型推理
papers.tldr: Flow Matching 视觉生成推理需多次顺序函数评估，现有加速方法常带来额外训练开销、质量下降且忽略输入差异。COFLOW 作为推理时方法，依据提示特征为每次生成自适应选择步数，并用无监督奖励在线训练上下文选择器，兼顾效率与保真。它在图像和视频生成上实现超 2.5 倍加速并保持感知与语义质量，且即插即用无需重训底模。论文还给出前向欧拉离散化的 O(1/K) 误差界，为高效自适应采样提供理论与实用支撑。
papers.abstract_en: Flow Matching enables high-quality visual generation via continuous-time dynamics, but inference remains costly due to multiple sequential function evaluations. Existing acceleration methods reduce the number of function evaluations but often introduce additional training overhead, degrade quality, or fail to account for input-dependent variability. We propose COFLOW, an inference-time method that adaptively selects the step counts each generation based on the prompt features. Our context-aware COFLOW is trained online with an unsupervised reward that balances inference efficiency and generation fidelity. Our method is plug-and-play, requiring no retraining of the underlying generative model. It generalizes to image and video generation, achieving over 2.5x speedup while preserving perceptual and semantic quality. We further provide a theoretical analysis establishing an O(1/K) forward-Euler discretization error bound under standard regularity conditions.

papers.title_en: FASTER: Fast Adjoint Stochastic Transport for Endpoint Refinement in Reward-Guided Image Editing
papers.authors: Yimiao Zhou, Zejia Zhong, Jingya Wang, Ye Shi
papers.evidence: 结合奖励模型与内容保持的奖励引导编辑
papers.tldr: 奖励引导图像编辑需在提升目标奖励的同时保留源内容与视觉合理性，但现有方法反复调用预训练大模型甚至反传，代价高。FASTER提出联合建模奖励、源保持与预训练先验的理论框架，将目标分布与实现动力学解耦，并为每个源图和目标训练小型网络完成低成本编辑。候选输出由预训练与奖励模型反馈，且反馈可在多次小网络更新中复用，避免把生成主干放入内层优化。在SD3上四项主指标领先，相比沿预训练轨迹优化控制的基线，SD3与SD1.5编辑加速最高6.91倍和24.14倍。
papers.abstract_en: Reward-guided image editing at test time seeks to improve a specified reward while preserving source content and visual plausibility. Many existing approaches optimize candidates through pretrained generation processes, making repeated adjustment depend on costly large-model execution and, in some cases, backbone backpropagation. We develop a theoretical framework that jointly accounts for reward, source preservation, and pretrained-prior preferences, allowing the desired output distribution to be specified separately from the dynamics used to realize it. Based on this framework, we introduce FASTER, which trains a small network for each source and objective to perform inexpensive editing, while pretrained and reward models provide feedback on candidate outputs. By reusing each candidate and its feedback across multiple small-network updates, FASTER reduces repeated sampling and supervision queries without placing the pretrained generative backbone inside the inner optimization loop. On SD3, FASTER leads all four target metrics and several validation metrics among the evaluated methods. Compared with the evaluated baseline that optimizes controls along pretrained generation trajectories, FASTER achieves editing-time speedups of up to \({6.91\times}\) on Stable Diffusion 3 and \({24.14\times}\) on Stable Diffusion 1.5.

papers.title_en: S2PD: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion for Physically and Logically Consistent Video Generation
papers.authors: Jeffrey Hu, Daniel Olmeda Reino, Ayush Tewari
papers.evidence: 具备物理与逻辑一致性的视频扩散生成
papers.tldr: 双向视频扩散虽能并行去噪整段视频，却仍易违反物理规律和符号规则。S2PD 在高噪声阶段采用自回归扩散，以串行计算协调相互依赖事件并生成有效状态转移；到低噪声阶段切换为并行扩散，联合精修整段视频并降低采样时间。作者用从零训练的像素空间扩散 Transformer 和经 LoRA 适配的预训练视频模型验证。在游戏、物理仿真和真实视频中，S2PD 比匹配的双向基线更可靠地遵循规则，并比其它串行方法更稳定、更高效。
papers.abstract_en: Bidirectional video diffusion models denoise entire videos in parallel, yet when trained on effectively unlimited in-distribution data from procedural generators, continue to violate physical laws and simple symbolic rules. We introduce Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD), which performs autoregressive diffusion at high noise before switching to parallel diffusion at low noise. The autoregressive phase provides the serial computation needed to coordinate interdependent events and produce valid state transitions while the parallel phase jointly refines the entire video and reduces sampling time relative to fully serial generation. We implement S2PD with two architectures: a pixel-space diffusion transformer trained from scratch and a pretrained video model adapted through LoRA fine-tuning with causal attention. Across games, physical simulations, and real video, S2PD follows rules more reliably than matched bidirectional baselines and generates videos with greater temporal stability and sampling efficiency than other serial methods.
